title: Market-entry coordination for Reserved Capacity SKU bundles and new-region enablement
creator: Ava Patel
description: Coordinate cross-functional readiness for bringing two new Reserved Capacity SKU bundles (r4-family and x1-flex) online in APAC and LATAM pilot regions. This ticket centralizes the market-entry schedule, partner operations checklist, billing SKU mapping, release-note copy, and the contingency plan for region backfill. Goal: ensure customers in pilot regions can reserve capacity, see correct billing SKUs, and receive clear release notes and partner comms at go-live. This is a market-entry coordination ticket (not the infra rollout). Deliverables include: finalized SKU naming and billing codes, partner enablement deck, release notes draft for Console/Docs/Portal, updated marketplace listings, and a pre-launch war room runbook.
acceptance_criteria: Billing: Billing team confirms SKU codes and pricing tiers for r4 and x1-flex and provides test invoices for pilot customers
Console: Reservation flow in Console shows correct human-readable SKU labels and estimated throughput for both families
Docs: Release notes and a migration FAQ published in docs.redwood.ai and linked in Console
Partner ops: Channel partners receive enablement deck and a 1-hour Q&A session scheduled
Support: Support playbook created with runbooks for ticket triage and known-error responses
Telemetry: Monitoring dashboard with reservation success rate and first-hour latency is live in Grafana
tasks: Confirm final SKU IDs and billing mapping with Finance (owner: Finance Ops)
Draft release notes copy for Console, Docs, and knowledge base (owner: PM)
Create partner enablement deck and record 30-min walkthrough (owner: Growth)
Coordinate with Eng to confirm reservation API contract and rollout window (owner: ENG-7849)
Define support runbook and escalation path (owner: Support)
Publish marketplace changes and coordinate cloud partner listings (owner: Partnerships)
QA Console reservation UX in staging region and capture screenshots for docs (owner: Design/QA)
Schedule pre-launch war room and invite leads from Eng/Finance/Support/Partners/Legal
risks: Billing SKU mismatch causing incorrect invoices for pilot customers
Console label mismatch leading to customer confusion and support churn
Partner marketplace listing rejection due to incomplete metadata
Engineering delays on API contract could push back reservation activation window
Insufficient monitoring coverage causing blind spots during initial reservations
comms_plan: Week -2: Internal pre-brief for Eng/Finance/Support/Partnerships with deck and risk register
Week -1: Publish release notes draft to docs.redwood.ai and request feedback from legal and security
Release day: Console banner + in-product tooltip explaining new reserved SKUs; targeted email to pilot customers
Post-release Day 1: 30-min debrief with war room and public status note if issues seen
Week +1: Partner office hours and support ticket triage follow-up
release_notes_draft: Reserved Capacity: New SKU bundles r4-family and x1-flex are available in APAC pilot and LATAM pilot regions. These bundles offer pre-committed throughput with predictable pricing and optional burst capacity. Customers can reserve capacity via Console > Dedicated > Reservables. Important: billing codes are R4-BNDL and X1F-BNDL respectively; invoices will reflect these codes. See migration FAQ for mapping from previous one-off SKUs. If you have subscription discounts, contact Finance to apply to reservations.
